caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a head with exaggerated facial features, viewed straight-on. The skin is rendered in shades of tan, brown, pink, and purple, suggesting shadows and facial contours. The cheeks, nose, and chin are prominent, and the lips are painted a bright red. The eyes are large, round, and wide open, with dark pupils and light-colored sclera. Sparse, fine black and gray lines on the top of the head represent thin, wispy hair. The ears are rounded and protrude slightly from each side of the head. The neck is cylindrical and features a protruding dot or knob at the center front, as well as lines suggesting mechanical or jointed elements along the sides. The overall composition centers the head inside a faint rectangular border on a blank, light-colored background. The artist's name, "Bertha Semple," is written in small capital letters in the lower right corner inside the border.
title: Wood Chopper Puppet
